# Meadowlark Pantry Storage Customer Demographic Analysis
Survey results and launch recommendation | Prepared 02/18/2026 by Paul Santoro

## Research design
Meadowlark Home Goods surveyed 400 U.S. adults who had purchased pantry storage products in the past 12 months. The online survey ran 02/02/2026–02/09/2026; respondents were recruited from a consumer research panel. Results are descriptive and are not weighted to U.S. population estimates. Tyrone Pruitt reviewed the questionnaire; Samuel Maddox supplied the market-sizing inputs.

## Demographics and stated purchase intent
Purchase intent is the share rating the concept 4 or 5 on a five-point scale.

| Age | Respondents | Share of sample | Purchase intent |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| 25–34 | 120 | 30% | 42% |
| 35–44 | 140 | 35% | 48% |
| 45–54 | 80 | 20% | 55% |
| 55–64 | 60 | 15% | 38% |

Respondents aged 35–44 were the largest group, while the 45–54 group reported the highest purchase intent. Across all respondents, 62% preferred clear, stackable containers; 51% cited easier cabinet organization as their main need. Among respondents with children under 18, 71% preferred dishwasher-safe products.

## Market estimate and recommendation
The initial serviceable audience is estimated at 12,000 U.S. households matching the survey's recent-category-purchase criterion. Applying the overall 8% purchase forecast yields 1,200 likely buyers during the first 12 months. This is a directional estimate, not a sales commitment.

Prioritize adults aged 35–44 in launch messaging because this group had the strongest purchase intent. Lead with clear, stackable containers and test dishwasher-safe claims in creative aimed at households with children. Reassess after the first 90 days using site conversion and paid-search data.
